publish_time.format: Seconds since the Unix epoch, with fractional seconds.
publish_time.quote: the time at which the message was published

insert_id.format: An opaque token, unique per log entry.

log_name.format: projects/<project>/logs/<log id> or organizations/<org>/logs/<log id>, URL-encoded.

examples.note: A Workspace login entry; see the gsuite_routes_to_data_access hazard.

severity.format: One fixed word, Cloud Logging's LogSeverity enum.

NOTICE.meaning: Normal but significant events, such as start up, shut down, or a configuration change.

INFO.meaning: Routine information, such as ongoing status or performance.

method_name.format: A dotted or camel-case API method name; this pack's record-type discriminator.

SetIamPolicy.meaning: An IAM policy binding was added or removed on the named resource.

jobservice.jobcompleted.meaning: A BigQuery job (here, a query) finished.

compute.instances.migrateOnHostMaintenan.meaning: Compute Engine live-migrated a VM instance off a host during maintenance.

google.login.LoginService.loginSuccess.meaning: A Workspace user signed in successfully.

principal_email.format: An email address, including a *.gserviceaccount.com service account or a bare system@ actor.

examples.note: A system-driven system_event record, not a real mailbox.

caller_ip.format: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or the literal 'private' for an internal call.

caller_user_agent.format: The client's own free-text user agent string.

resource_name.format: A slash-delimited resource path, whose shape depends on the service.

request_resource.format: A bare project id, on the SetIamPolicy sample.

resource_type.format: One fixed word, a Cloud Monitoring monitored-resource type.

gae_app.meaning: A single instance of an App Engine application version.

bigquery_resource.meaning: A BigQuery resource such as a job or dataset.

audited_resource.meaning: A Google Cloud resource that produces an audit log, labeled with its project, service and method.
audited_resource.quote: A Google Cloud resource that produces an audit log

project_id.format: A Google Cloud project id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

instance_id.format: A large decimal integer, unique within Compute Engine.

zone.format: A Compute Engine zone name, region plus a letter suffix.

operation_id.format: An opaque token the producer assigns.

examples.value: Instance migrated during Compute Engine maintenance.

cim_action.format: One fixed word, the TA's own classification.

modified.meaning: Observed on the SetIamPolicy sample: a configuration change.

success.meaning: Observed on the BigQuery job-completed and Workspace login-success samples.

failure.meaning: Observed on the Workspace login-failure sample.

unknown.meaning: Observed on the system_event VM-migration sample, despite the operation completing successfully; the TA's methodName-to-action mapping has no entry for it.

success.meaning: The only value observed in this pack, on every container it is bound to, regardless of what actually happened; see the status_constant hazard.

iam_role.format: roles/<service>.<role>, an IAM predefined or custom role name.

iam_member.quote: Principals represent one or more identities

ADD.meaning: The binding was added to the policy.

REMOVE.meaning: The binding was removed from the policy.

bq_job_id.format: bqjob_r<hex>_<hex>_<n>, BigQuery's own job id format.

bq_statement_type.format: One fixed word, a BigQuery SQL statement type.

QUERY_INTERACTIVE.meaning: The query ran immediately, at interactive priority.

CREATE_IF_NEEDED.meaning: The job may create the destination table if it does not already exist.

WRITE_TRUNCATE.meaning: The job overwrites the destination table's existing rows.

DONE.meaning: The job finished (successfully or not; check the job's own error field).

examples.note: An anonymous dataset BigQuery generates for a query with no destination table named.
An anonymous destination table BigQuery generates for an unnamed query result.

bq_bytes_billed.format: An integer byte count, rounded up to BigQuery's billing quantum.

login_event_name.format: A lower_snake_case event name from the Reports API login catalog.

login_type.format: One fixed word naming the credential type.

google_password.meaning: The user provided a Google account password.
google_password.quote: The user provides a Google account password.

saml.meaning: The user provided a SAML assertion from a SAML identity provider.

exchange.meaning: The user exchanged an existing credential for another type.

reauth.meaning: The user was already authenticated but had to reauthorize.

google_password.meaning: Observed on the login-success sample, matching login_type.

unknown.meaning: Observed on the login-failure sample even though login_type read google_password on the same record; see the auth_method_mismatch hazard.
